description: This PHP source file defines the Cryptographer class, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using AES and Rijndael algorithms within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: A utility class for secure encryption and decryption of strings using AES and Rijndael encryption algorithms with configurable key and block lengths.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer with a secret key used for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using Rijndael cipher, returning the encrypted data as an uppercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted hexadecimal string back to the original plaintext using AES.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a consistent encryption key by XOR-ing the provided key with null bytes to match the required key length.
